reason: The one caller passes a real clock reading taken once (app.rs:254) and used for materialize at app.rs:598-603 (signing_plane is pub(crate), lib.rs:256, so no other caller exists); it can only lag. The PEP's `now` is a fresh now_unix() per request (app.rs:830), carried as the exchange's single reading into ResponseSigning::window (answering_commitment.rs:80) -> signing_window::open -> DelegatedSigningReader::current (signing_window.rs:18-26, reader.rs:45-47). HttpProfileProxy::handle(req, now) is pub (http_profile_serve/mod.rs:437), but its caller is the composition root, not an attacker; the r10 attacker story (request-influenced or per-connection now) has no production path.
